name: @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-video-production
description: TypeScript port of the veo-generator + veo-showreel-production-kit pi skills. Parses a scripted shot package (shots/*.md) and renders one mp4 clip per camera cut with the Google Veo 3.1 API, plus storyboard first-frame generation via nano-banana. Exposed
